pages.text: Emberveil has no levels. Danger comes from $(l)where$() you are. This book rates places and foes in four tiers:

$(li)$(tier1): what vanilla iron gear handles.$(li)$(tier2): diamond gear, good food and a plan.$(li)$(tier3): enchanted diamond or better, potions, and a retreat route.$(li)$(tier4): netherite-class gear and practice.

$(li)$(tier1) Plains, forests, shallow caves, villages, small dungeons, witch huts.$(li)$(tier2) Jungles and savannas at night, the deep layer, deserts' temples, strongholds, mineshafts, Wrought Chambers, Umvuthana groves, illager forts.$(li)$(tier3) Mansions, the Nether's fortresses, frozen mountain lairs, ocean monuments, the Labyrinth, the first Cataclysm lairs.$(li)$(tier4) The great Cataclysm bosses and the End.
pages.title: Where each tier lives
